## How to Retrigger FDB

Please follow the steps below to retrigger the Full Downstream Build (FDB):

1. Click the **Details** button next to the _Full downstream build_ PR check.
2. This will take you to the pipeline run.
3. Click on **Action → Rerun** to restart it.

> If you do not have access to IBM Cloud, please contact an admin or [rishiraj.anand@ibm.com](mailto:rishiraj.anand@ibm.com).
